title: Dak Nong geopark in two days
summary: Day one: Gia Nghia and basalt coffee. Day two: Dray Sap on the Serepok. Ta Dung, Lieng Nung, and the lava tubes are dossier sights until licensed photos land.

days.title: Day 1 — Gia Nghia
days.body: Town crossroads, a coffee stop on basalt farms, and time for Lieng Nung or EXPLORASOUND when you are driving yourself.

days.title: Day 2 — Krong No
days.body: Long drive to Dray Sap on the Serepok. Lawful cave visits such as C9 need a guide and are not a casual add-on.

stops.name: Gia Nghia crossroads
stops.note: QL14 and QL28 base. Lieng Nung, the lithophone hall, and EXPLORASOUND sit on short drives east of town.

stops.name: Vietnamese coffee
stops.note: Afternoon on a farm road; no roast profile invented here.

stops.name: Dray Sap Waterfall
stops.note: Day two. Handbook distance is about 110 km from Gia Nghia. Gate and hours check on arrival.

stops.name: Da Lat pairing
stops.note: Optional if Lien Khuong is your flight and you are linking cool hills with the geopark.

seoDescription: A two-day Gia Nghia plan with basalt coffee and a Krong No day for Dray Sap. Ta Dung and the caves stay research-only until sight photos publish.
